nodes.summary: Let $W$ be a Hermitian $n \times n$ complex matrix with real eigenvalues $\lambda_1, \dots, \lambda_n$, listed with multiplicity. The empirical spectral measure of $W$ is the measure $\frac{1}{n} \sum_{j=1}^{n} \delta_{\lambda_j}$ on $\mathbb{R}$, where $\delta_\lambda$ is the Dirac measure at $\lambda$; for $n = 0$ it is the zero measure.
nodes.title: Empirical spectral measure of a Hermitian matrix

nodes.summary: The semicircle distribution is the measure $\sigma$ on $\mathbb{R}$ given by $\sigma(A) = \int_{A \cap [-2, 2]} \frac{\sqrt{4 - x^2}}{2\pi} \, dx$ for every measurable set $A \subseteq \mathbb{R}$.
nodes.title: Semicircle distribution

nodes.summary: For every family of real functions $X_{ij} : \Omega \to \mathbb{R}$, $i, j \in \mathbb{N}$, on a set $\Omega$, every $n \in \mathbb{N}$ and every $\omega \in \Omega$, the Wigner matrix $W_n(\omega)$ is Hermitian.
nodes.title: Wigner matrices are Hermitian

nodes.summary: Let $X_{ij} : \Omega \to \mathbb{R}$, for $i, j \in \mathbb{N}$, be real functions on a set $\Omega$. For $n \in \mathbb{N}$ and $\omega \in \Omega$, the Wigner matrix $W_n(\omega)$ is the $n \times n$ complex matrix, with rows and columns indexed by $\{0, \dots, n - 1\}$, whose entry at $(i, j)$ is the real number $X_{\min(i, j)\, \max(i, j)}(\omega)$.
